description: This file implements a WebKit-based browser component within the WPEFramework, providing functionalities such as configuration management, JavaScript execution, cookie management, event handling, and communication with other system components.

classes.name: WebKitImplementation
classes.description: The main class implementing a web browsing engine using WebKit within the WPEFramework, managing configuration, events, cookies, scripting, and system interaction.

methods.name: CloseDown
methods.description: Cleanup function registered with atexit to destroy the singleton instance and shutdown messaging.

methods.name: WKStringToString
methods.description: Converts a WKStringRef to a std::string.

methods.name: ConvertWKArrayToStringVector
methods.description: Converts a WKArrayRef of WKStringRef to a vector of strings.

methods.name: GetPageActiveURL
methods.description: Retrieves the active URL from a WKPageRef.

methods.name: SendToBridge
methods.description: Sends a message to the web page's bridge with a specified name and payload.

methods.name: CollectGarbage
methods.description: Triggers JavaScript garbage collection in the web context.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the context of the web page.

methods.name: AddUserScript
methods.description: Adds a user script to be injected into the page.

methods.name: RemoveAllUserScripts
methods.description: Removes all injected user scripts from the page.

methods.name: CookieJar
methods.description: Retrieves the current cookie jar data, including version, checksum, and payload.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for cookie jar change notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for cookie jar change notifications.

methods.name: NotifyCookieJarChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients that the cookie jar has changed.

methods.name: RefreshCookieJar
methods.description: Refreshes the stored cookies from the WebKit cookie manager.

methods.name: SetCookies
methods.description: Sets cookies in the web context from a vector of cookie strings.

methods.name: GetCookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies from the web context as a vector of strings.
